description: Every rpc declared under proto/ must have a UDTS spec and a consumer (FSD §12, §15). Key: 'package.Service/Rpc'.

pm.connector.v1.ConnectorService/Capabil.notes: Manifest echo (§15): module, type, code, contract, adjudicated capabilities.

pm.connector.v1.ConnectorService/HealthC.notes: Common connector probe (§10): SERVING, DEGRADED (IdP discovery failing), NOT_SERVING; pm-core routes around DEGRADED instances once the registry lands (slice 4b).

pm.connector.v1.IdpiService/Authenticate.notes: First leg of the code flow: PKCE authorization URL plus the random state and verifier the module mints and pm-core keeps in its pending-login record (CodeQL go/constant-oauth2-state closed 2026-10-23 by moving the state mint into the module).

pm.connector.v1.IdpiService/CompleteAuth.notes: Second leg: code exchange, id token verified (issuer, signature, audience or azp, nonce), claims extracted. Happy path covered by the Keycloak integration test only through the error path (no browser in CI); pm-core login (slice 4b) exercises it end to end.

pm.connector.v1.IdpiService/Logout.notes: Refresh-token revocation at the IdP plus the RP-initiated end-session URL.

pm.connector.v1.IdpiService/RefreshToken.notes: Refresh grant; INVALID_ARGUMENT on invalid_grant, UNAVAILABLE when the IdP is down.

pm.connector.v1.IdpiService/ResolveClaim.notes: Pure claims-to-roles mapping (§04) from connectors/idpi/oidc/mapping.yaml: platform roles, pools, attributes.

pm.connector.v1.IdpiService/ValidateToke.notes: Signature, issuer, expiry, audience; OK with valid=false for a bad token.

pm.core.v1.VersionService/GetVersion.notes: First served RPC; exercises buf generation, the gRPC server, and the UDTS pattern.
